credentials_json_env.description: Name of the env var that holds the path to the OAuth2 credentials JSON file downloaded from Google Cloud Console.

token_path.description: Absolute path to the OAuth token cache file. Default: ~/.local/share/pyhall/google_calendar_token.json

default_calendar_id.description: Calendar ID used when no --calendar-id flag is passed. 'primary' resolves to the authenticated user's primary calendar.

env.description: Runtime environment. Controls attestation strictness: dev=soft, prod=hard-fail.
